letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai or a cool Ahmedabad breeze reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful life with you. I still smile thinking of our wedding day on 23 February—how we danced under the stars, promising forever. Your laughter is my favorite soundtrack, your smile my daily sunrise. You’re my cutie, my confidante, the heart that steadies my wanderings. No matter where we are, my love follows you like a gentle wind, ever‑present, ever‑warm.
poem:
From desert dunes to Gujarat’s hue,  
Your love’s the compass I pursue.  
In every laugh, in every sigh,  
Together, love, we touch the sky.
